tagline: Create personal Todoist tasks from Jira issues and sync completions back
metaTitle: Jira Software Cloud + Todoist: Assignments as Tasks
metaDescription: Turn Jira assignments into Todoist tasks, sync completions back to Jira, and surface overdue issues as urgent tasks. GAIA maps projects. See the setup steps.
intro:
Engineers who use Todoist as their personal task hub face a daily friction. Assignments live in Jira, but the day gets planned in the task list, and keeping both aligned requires constant manual effort. An assigned issue needs to be added to the list by hand. A task completed there needs to be marked done on the issue by hand. Over time, the two fall out of sync and engineers either abandon the task list or lose trust in the issue statuses.

GAIA removes this friction by bridging Jira and Todoist automatically. When an issue is assigned to you, GAIA creates the corresponding task with the right project, priority, and due date. When you complete it, GAIA transitions the issue to Done. You manage your day in your task list and your team sees accurate status.

This integration is ideal for engineers who value a personal task management system that gives them a unified view of all their work — code reviews, meetings, errands, and tickets — in one place.

useCases.title: Auto-create Todoist tasks from Jira assignments
useCases.description: When an issue is assigned to you, GAIA immediately creates a matching task with the issue summary, priority, due date, and a direct link to the issue so your personal task list is always current.

useCases.title: Sync completions back to Jira
useCases.description: When you check off a linked task, GAIA transitions the corresponding issue to your configured Done state so the team board stays accurate without requiring you to open Jira.

useCases.title: Map each project key to a Todoist project
useCases.description: GAIA routes assignments to the appropriate project based on the project key, keeping your engineering work organized separately from personal tasks in your workspace.

useCases.title: Surface overdue issues as urgent tasks
useCases.description: When an issue assigned to you passes its due date without being resolved, GAIA creates or updates the task with urgent priority and an overdue flag so it surfaces prominently in your daily planning.

useCases.title: Daily queue review task
useCases.description: Each morning GAIA creates a task with a summary of your queue, issues in progress, upcoming due dates, and new assignments, so you start the day with a prioritized view of your workload.

howItWorks.step: Connect Jira and Todoist to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with both accounts. It identifies your Jira user and maps your assignments to your Todoist workspace.

howItWorks.step: Configure project mapping and completion sync
howItWorks.description: Map project keys to projects, set the transition that a completion should trigger, and choose whether to sync in both directions or only from issues to tasks.

howItWorks.step: Manage your workload while statuses stay current
howItWorks.description: GAIA creates tasks as you receive assignments and syncs completions back automatically. You plan your day in your task list while your team sees real-time status.

faqs.question: Does GAIA create Todoist tasks for all Jira issues in my project or only assignments?
faqs.answer: By default GAIA creates tasks only for issues assigned to your user. You can optionally extend this to issues you are watching, issues in a specific sprint, or issues with a label you specify.

faqs.question: What transition does GAIA use when I complete a task?
faqs.answer: During setup you choose which workflow transition maps to task completion. For most teams this is the Done or Resolved transition, but you can map it to any transition in your project's workflow.

faqs.question: Can I snooze or reschedule a task without affecting the issue?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rescheduling, snoozing, adding subtasks, or editing the task title are local-only actions that do not affect the issue. Only task completion triggers a status update.
